verdict.rationale: Okta documents a first-party Cross App Access (XAA) pattern for securing agent-to-app connections with OIDC, and offers a free end-to-end playground for it, which covers the cross-app access part of the story. The evidence is limited to developer blog posts, and nothing addresses token vaulting or scoped agent credentials. The MCP server is an admin-management integration, not an agent-identity pattern. Missing for 10: token vaulting, scoped agent credentials, agents as first-class identity objects, in-depth reference docs beyond blog posts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, AI agents are first-class identities — documented patterns for securing agent access to apps (cross-app access, token vaulting, scoped agent credentials)
